ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and localized linear streaks. High specular glare on the right lobe and center creates localized saturation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips. Irregular white mottling present along the lower-left leading edge. Low-intensity black dominates the central and proximal areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the right lobe trailing edge. The left lobe trailing edge features a distinct, high-amplitude smooth U-shaped indentation (crevasse) positioned mid-lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges from tip to notch; convex curvature along the leading/outer edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned vertical and diagonal high-contrast linear marks (rake marks/scratches) detected across the central and right lobe surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, deep geometric notch or missing tissue section (crevasse) on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe lobe. Large barnacle colonies at both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific combination of the deep left-lobe trailing edge indentation and symmetric barnacle clusters at the tips.
